title: From Pilot to Platform: Scaling Coding Agents Across Teams
description:
Scaling agentic development is a complex challenge. While it's easy for one team to find their groove with coding agents, implementing this at scale across multiple teams can disrupt your entire workflow. Expect inconsistent practices, broken APIs, and varied agent behaviors causing chaos from one repository to another. Solutions exist, but only if you understand the foundational components that make scaling possible. 

Guy Podjarny, the Founder & CEO of Tessl, and Patrick Debois, the Head of Product DevRel at Tessl, bring invaluable insights to this topic. Guy's experience in scaling startups like Snyk and founding Tessl equips him to offer strategic guidance on agent enablement. Patrick, a pioneer of DevOps, connects agentic approaches to industry best practices, ensuring that the scaling process preserves team velocity and governance standards.

What we cover:
• How operating models determine agent adoption and ownership
• Governance patterns that balance standards and speed
• What are the "golden paths" for agent behavior and repos?
• Techniques for distributing shared rules and context
• Common failure modes in scaling agents, and how to avoid them
